name: How can I prevent black spots from appearing on my walls?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent black spots from appearing on my walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing black spots, often mold, on walls involves controlling moisture and improving ventilation. Regularly check for and promptly repair leaks in pipes, roofs, or foundations. Use exhaust fans in bathrooms and kitchens during and after showering or cooking. Maintain indoor humidity levels below 60% with dehumidifiers if necessary. Ensure proper air circulation by avoiding overcrowding spaces and keeping furniture slightly away from walls, especially in damp areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent black spots (mold) by controlling moisture, fixing leaks, using exhaust fans, maintaining low indoor humidity, and ensuring good air circulation in your home.
